title: Relative physical accuracy survives rare conditioning
statement: For t=beta/2,h=max_i(|b_i|+sum_j!=i|J_ij|),delta=t/M and either positive symmetric product orientation,B_M=(exp(delta V/2)exp(delta T)exp(delta V/2))^M obeys |log[(B_M)_ab/(exp(tK))_ab]|<=E_M on EVERY supported endpoint pair. Sufficient E_M=(th/M)[2t sum_i(|b_i|+Gamma_i)+2t sum_i<j|J_ij|+n],M>=max(1,th);endpoint-specific n can be Hamming distance. Zero-rate required flip is exact support zero for BOTH kernels. Jumpwise |Q-I|<=h delta Nflips includes multiple jumps/cell;conditioned parity-path MGF/Jensen gives two-sided relative bounds without inverse endpoint amplitude or random-grid-shift premise. Original Hamiltonian strengths,not auxiliary center fields. Common nonnegative filtering of amplitudes with ratios in[e^-E,e^E] gives affinity>=sechE,filtered-state full trace distance<=2tanhE_M and |log(P_M(e)/P(e))|<=4E_M,without1/P(e). V-outside half-kernel squaring is inherited uniform2M cycle,with2n endpoint bits as time0/half-period pins. Vuong jump-count ancestry retained;no unproved pin bridge.
